disclaimer: For reflection and entertainment. Not professional advice.

headlines: The wind is at your back today
A day to step forward with ease
Doors open a little wider today
bodies: Things line up nicely today, {name}. Start the task you have been putting off. Your best window is {lucky_hour}.
Your {element} nature feels steady and strong. Face {lucky_direction} when you plan or write. A touch of {lucky_colour} adds a nice lift.
People are open to your ideas today. Share them kindly and clearly. Try to have key talks around {lucky_hour}.
A good day to begin, ask, or reach out. Keep your plans simple and your tone warm. {lucky_colour} suits your mood.
Momentum is on your side. Do one meaningful thing early, then enjoy the rest of the day. Sit facing {lucky_direction} if you can.
Small efforts go further than usual today. Say thank you, follow up, tidy one corner. Your {element} energy loves a clear space.

headlines: A kind day for routine work
bodies: Today supports steady effort, {name}. Finish what is in front of you before starting new things. {lucky_hour} is a good focus window.
Your {element} energy is balanced. Keep a light routine and a clear desk. Facing {lucky_direction} may help you settle.
A good day for small wins. Reply to messages, plan the week, share a meal. Wear a little {lucky_colour} for comfort.
No need to rush. Things move at a fair pace today. Save bigger decisions for after {lucky_hour} when your mind feels clear.
People around you are cooperative. Ask for help if you need it. A short walk can refresh your {element} side.
A reliable day for practical tasks. Tidy, sort, and prepare. Turn toward {lucky_direction} when you work.

headlines: A day of ups and downs
Take it one step at a time
A good day to keep it simple
bodies: Today has a bit of everything, {name}. Keep plans flexible and expectations light. {lucky_hour} may feel smoother than other hours.
Your {element} energy may feel a little scattered. Make a short list and tick off three things. That is enough.
Check details twice before you send or sign. Small slips are easy to fix if you slow down. A touch of {lucky_colour} can help you feel grounded.
Mixed signals are normal today. Listen more than you speak. Face {lucky_direction} when you need to think.
Choose rest and routine over big moves. Water a plant, clear a drawer, sleep a bit earlier.
Some things will flow, some will not. Put your energy where it flows. {lucky_hour} is your calmest window.

headlines: A quiet day for rest and review
A day to look after yourself
A good day to tend your own garden
bodies: Today is better for reflection than for big starts, {name}. Review, rest, and prepare. Tomorrow brings new energy.
Your {element} energy asks for a slower pace. Keep conversations kind and short. {lucky_hour} is a gentle time to get things done.
Hold off on major decisions if you can. If you must act, check twice and keep it simple. Face {lucky_direction} to steady your mind.
A good day for cleaning, tidying, and finishing old tasks. Clearing space often clears the mind too.
Be patient with yourself and others. Small misunderstandings pass quickly when met with calm. A little {lucky_colour} can feel comforting.
Think of today as a rest stop, not a roadblock. Recharge, drink water, and plan your next good step.

day_officers.meaning: A day of fresh starts and setting foundations.
A day to clear out the old and make room.
A day of abundance and gathering.
A level, ordinary day suited to steady work.
A settled day for commitments that should last.
A day to hold firm and follow through.
A day of breaking down. Best for endings and demolition.
A day to tread carefully and keep things modest.
A day when efforts come together nicely.
A day to collect, harvest, and wrap up.
A day of openings and welcome beginnings.
A day to close, store, and rest.

moving_house.label: Moving house
moving_house.do_text: A kind day to move in or carry in your first items.
moving_house.avoid_text: Perhaps not the day to move. Pack and prepare instead.

signing.label: Signing agreements
signing.do_text: A good day to sign and confirm plans.
signing.avoid_text: Read through again and consider signing another day.

travel.label: Travel
travel.do_text: A smooth day to set off on a trip.
travel.avoid_text: Allow extra time and keep travel plans simple.

haircut.label: Haircut
haircut.do_text: A fresh cut suits today's energy.
haircut.avoid_text: Maybe leave the haircut for another day.

wedding.label: Wedding
wedding.do_text: A warm, harmonious day for celebrations.
wedding.avoid_text: Many prefer another date for wedding ceremonies.

renovation.label: Renovation
renovation.do_text: A good day to start or continue home works.
renovation.avoid_text: Hold off on starting new works today.

business_opening.label: Business opening
business_opening.do_text: A welcoming day to open your doors.
business_opening.avoid_text: Consider a soft launch now and a grand opening later.

investment.label: Financial decisions
investment.do_text: A calm day to review plans. Always seek proper advice.
investment.avoid_text: Not a day for big money moves. Review and wait.

medical_checkup.label: Routine appointments
medical_checkup.do_text: A fine day for routine appointments you have planned.
medical_checkup.avoid_text: Keep any needed appointments. Simply avoid adding extra ones if they can wait.

prayer.label: Prayer and blessings
prayer.do_text: A peaceful day for prayer, offerings, and gratitude.
prayer.avoid_text: Keep prayers simple and quiet today.

cleaning.label: Cleaning and decluttering
cleaning.do_text: A great day to clean, sort, and let go.

interview.label: Interviews
interview.do_text: You come across clearly today. Good for interviews.
interview.avoid_text: Prepare a little extra and speak slowly.

first_date.label: First date
first_date.do_text: A warm day for meeting someone new.
first_date.avoid_text: Keep it casual. Coffee beats a big dinner today.

buying_property.label: Property matters
buying_property.do_text: A steady day for property viewings and decisions. Seek proper advice.
buying_property.avoid_text: View and compare, but decide another day.

groundbreaking.label: Groundbreaking
groundbreaking.do_text: A supportive day to break ground.
groundbreaking.avoid_text: Traditionally not a day to disturb the earth.

funeral_matters.label: Funeral matters
funeral_matters.do_text: A respectful day for rites and remembrance.
funeral_matters.avoid_text: Many families prefer another date for these rites.

clash_text: Today clashes with your {name} sign. Keep plans light and be extra kind to yourself.
A clash day for you. Slow down, double-check details, and skip big starts.
Your animal sign meets the day head-on. A good day for rest and routine.
Clash days can feel bumpy. Wear {lucky_colour} and keep your schedule simple.
Energy runs against your sign today. Let small things go and save big moves for later.
Treat today as a pause. Tidy, reflect, and look ahead to a smoother tomorrow.

dos: Respect quiet rituals in the Hungry Ghost period

focus.wood: Stand by people who stand by you.

rat.overview: A clash year with the Horse. Life may feel busy and changeable. Flexibility helps.
rat.career: Changes at work are possible. Stay adaptable and keep good records.
rat.money: Keep a buffer and avoid risky moves.
rat.health_wellbeing: Protect your rest and keep a calm routine.
rat.tai_sui_note: Clash (chōng 冲) with Tai Sui. Many people choose to pay respects to Tai Sui early in the year.

ox.overview: A harm year. Small misunderstandings may arise, but steady effort carries you.
ox.love: Speak clearly to avoid mixed signals.
ox.tai_sui_note: Harm (hài 害) with Tai Sui. Keep relationships clear and kind.

tiger.overview: A supportive year. The Horse is a trine ally, so energy flows well.
tiger.career: Good for growth and new roles.
tiger.tai_sui_note: Trine harmony (sān hé 三合) with Tai Sui.

rabbit.overview: A year of small breaks in routine. Keep plans flexible.
rabbit.tai_sui_note: Break (pò 破) with Tai Sui. Mild; keep things steady.

dragon.overview: A productive year with room to shine.

snake.overview: A bright year with Fire support.

horse.overview: Your own year. Energy is high but can feel restless.
horse.tai_sui_note: Ben ming nián (本命年) and self-punishment (zì xíng 自刑). Many people pay respects to Tai Sui.

goat.overview: A harmonious year with the Horse as your ally.
goat.tai_sui_note: Six harmony (liù hé 六合) with Tai Sui.

rooster.overview: A year for polish and refinement.

dog.overview: A supportive year. The Horse is a trine ally.
dog.tai_sui_note: Trine harmony (sān hé 三合) with Tai Sui.
